name: Acid Sprayer Trap (CR 6)
body:
Acid Sprayer Trap
CR 6

Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset no
Effect 6d6 acid damage to all targets within 20 feet of the trigger area, DC 20 Reflex save half.

Note Anyone attempting to disarm this trap must touch the acid to do so. A 20-pound stone chest containing treasure sits at the bottom of the wall pool. The chest sits on a pressure plate which, if disturbed, causes the fountainhead to spray acid on everyone within 20 feet.
